exposure: body mass index (BMI) of 40 kg/m(2) or greater
cohort: Obese women (BMI ≥ 40 kg/m2) who underwent cesarean delivery
finding: Implementation of a hospital protocol using negative pressure therapy after cesarean delivery in obese women led to a significant reduction in surgical site infections.
mod_finding: This study examined the association between negative pressure therapy (NPT) use and surgical site infection (SSI) after cesarean delivery in obese women, it did not compare different modes of delivery.
